audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits: a range-vs-threat poke war where Syndra owns every stage she can reach him and Ziggs owns the ones she cannot. 48.48% WR over 4138 games supports even-slightly-Ziggs-by-numbers, Syndra-by-agency.
All 4 spikes present and Ziggs-specific (Satchel bait, level 6 R all-in vs poke kit, Luden's burst, late pick vs siege). Matches packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six full phases[].side rows read Skill while content win[] and the packet chart read Syndra on all seven. breakdown.cooldowns has no digit. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are pasted trade strings. tradeBad (and its copies in breakdown.trading and report[3]) warns about 'the dash you bought it for' — Ziggs has no dash; his escape is Satchel Charge's self-knockback. The two missing interactions (Short Fuse auto-reset burst tell; Satchel's percent-health damage punishing raw resistances) appear nowhere.
audit.why: Content whys are Syndra-winning and match the packet on every row; the full layer carries blanket Skill. Real numbers: Satchel Charge 20/18/16/14/12s — his only self-peel; Hexplosive Minefield 16s; Mega Inferno Bomb 120/95/70. Short Fuse resets on ability casts, making the empowered auto wind-up the trade tell.
audit.corrected: Sides flipped to Syndra on the six rows (win[] already agrees — side alone per chart rule). Cooldowns rewritten with numbers. Bleed bullets rewritten to their titles. tradeBad rewritten around the Short Fuse tell, with breakdown.trading and report[3] copies updated to match.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Scatter the Weak like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge: 20s at rank 1, 12s at max — his only escape. Once it is spent he is catchable for most of a wave; that is the commit window. - Hexplosive Minefield is 16s: with mines down, walk the wave's edge, not through it. - Your E is 15s — guard it like a fifth summoner spell.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Spheres pre-placed by the wave make your QE stun instant — Ziggs has to dodge on reaction, and his 20s Satchel is the only tool that answers it. Two banked spheres turn his every step-up into a coin he loses.
